items.text: Round-001 decisions d1–d4 all resolved to option A (the recommended choice) and were incorporated into plan.md §Contract Decisions, §Scope, §Target End State, §Implementation Strategy, §Testing Plan, §Rollout Checklist, §Risks, §Non-goals, and §Definition of Done. Empty-state = omit, label = 'Depends on', upstream-only, no truncation.
Plan is self-consistent: each of the four surfaces (CLI get, CLI list, UI detail, UI list) now has identical rules for wording, empty-state, direction, and long-list handling. No TBD markers remain.

File-level discovery (exact Go formatter functions and TSX components) is still deferred to the executing agent — this workspace does not contain scenarios/swarm-manager/. Hints are in plan.md §Current Technical Context and that is the appropriate place for them; it does not block readiness.

Backlog item has no `initiative` field, so cross-initiative context was not loaded. If the orchestrator wants this grouped with other CLI/UI display fixes, set it via `swarm-manager backlog update --data '{"initiative":"..."}'` before execution.
Recommended next step: mark ready — `swarm-manager backlog update --kind fix --name swarm-manager-initiative-depends-on-display --data '{"status":"ready"}'` and queue.
